newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude advances in late day U.S. paper trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude advances in late day U.S. paper trade.

text.p: World benchmark North Sea Brent crude oil advanced modestly in late day U.S. paper trade from its earlier settlement of $17.85 a barrel traders said.
A European major sold two cargoes worth of paper to a Wall Street trading house -- one at $17.95 a barrel and the other at $17.93.
A number of partial cargoes were also sold, most at the unchanged level of $17.85, and others at $17.86, $17.87 and $17.90.
The Wall Street player was far and away the biggest buyer.
